items.html: *Now, the place of the extension of all these Partzufim, male and female, that are made from the union of MA and BON, as above — their place is where the Nekudot were originally, which emerged through the Nikvey Einayim, that is, from the Tabur of AK to the end of his legs. And the light of the forehead, called the name MA, although it emerged from above the forehead, spreads from there downward, and its existence begins from the Tabur to the very end of his legs.
